definition: Rejecting accepted religious beliefs or teachings.
author: Oscar Wilde
quote: They savour of the heretical views of the Anabaptists, views that I have completely refuted in four of my unpublished sermons.
example_sentence: Suggesting a later kick-off was considered heretical.
